verdict.rationale: Supabase ships a documented AI Assistant in the Dashboard that takes natural-language input to design schemas, generate SQL, and deploy Edge Functions, plus a first-party MCP server (with live, OAuth-gated endpoint confirmed by probe) exposing tools like execute_sql/apply_migration/deploy_edge_function that let any NL-driven agent (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) operate the project conversationally, backed by Agent Skills/plugins for setup. Community reports confirm real-world agent usage (e.g., Cursor assistant operating the DB), though with security caveats around elevated access rather than functional failure. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of NL command accuracy/reliability beyond vendor-run 'Supabase Evals'.
